"""Intent tests for M1-T14: mdata.validate_rows drops unusable rows and resolves duplicates (DATA-02)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata import RawRow, validate_rows


def _rows(raw: list[list]) -> list[RawRow]:
    return [RawRow(date=d, ticker=t, close=c) for d, t, c in raw]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc01_unusable_rows_dropped_later_duplicate_kept_sorted(golden) -> None:
    """TC-01: blank, zero and negative closes gone; later duplicate wins; sorted by (date, ticker). Exact."""
    given, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-01")
    result = validate_rows(_rows(given["rows"]), given["tickers"])
    assert result == _rows(expected["rows"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc01_result_is_list_of_rawrow(golden) -> None:
    given, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-01")
    result = validate_rows(_rows(given["rows"]), given["tickers"])
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    assert len(result) == len(expected["rows"])
    assert all(isinstance(row, RawRow) for row in result)


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc01_default_tickers_matches_none(golden) -> None:
    given, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-01")
    assert validate_rows(_rows(given["rows"])) == _rows(expected["rows"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_requested_ticker_absent_raises_keyerror_naming_it(golden) -> None:
    given, _ = golden("mdata", "TC-01")
    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="ZZZ"):
        validate_rows(_rows(given["rows"]), ["A", "ZZZ"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_requested_ticker_with_only_unusable_rows_raises_keyerror(contract_sample) -> None:
    """A ticker whose only row has a blank close has no usable row."""
    sample = [RawRow(**row) for row in contract_sample("mdata.RawRow")["rows"]]
    blank = [row for row in sample if row.close is None]
    assert blank, "sample must carry a blank-close row"
    orphan = blank[0].ticker
    rows = [row for row in sample if row.ticker != orphan] + blank
    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match=orphan):
        validate_rows(rows, [orphan])
